title: Summary: Resolving Conflicts
objective: Create a conflict, print its status mark, resolve it, and print the subject of the merge commit.
hint: Set up the two conflicting headings and git merge --no-edit notes *> $null. Write-Output (git status --short) shows UU. Then set the README to # Notes from both, git add, git commit -q -m "Resolve heading conflict". Then Write-Output Merged: with $(git log -1 --format=%s).
